messages:
incident-bot: Paging @oncall_jordan — p99 latency breach detected for tenant AcmeHealth on us-west-2-dedicated. p95 rose from ~320ms to ~1.8s, p99 ~4.5s. Streaming stalls and partial responses observed. SLO p99 = 3.0s breached. Alert: <https://alerts.internal/alert/ACME-9876>

oncall_jordan: ack, I'm on it. Is the impact contained to AcmeHealth or seeing multi-tenant? @sre_maya @eng_aram please jump in.

sre_maya: confirmed single-tenant. Pattern: sudden fanout of concurrent sessions ~2.5k over 3m. Long prompts skewed right — median token length up ~3x normal, many >2000 tokens. KV cache miss ratio jumped to 92% for that tenant.

eng_aram: i'm seeing scheduling queues back up on worker group usw2-dedicated-gpu-rtx12. Continuous batching backlog spikes. Logs show repeated GC and cuda mem fallback errors around the same window: `kernel_select(): fallback -> fp32 (OOM heur)`

eng_aram: sharing quick debug snippets: 
```
# check pod queue lengths
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=usw2-dedicated -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,QUEUE:.metadata.annotations.queueDepth
# cache metrics
curl -s https://metrics.internal/tenants/acme/cache | jq '.'
```

oncall_jordan: thanks. Immediate mitigation ideas: 1) throttle AcmeHealth concurrency at edge for 15m 2) route AcmeHealth to a compatible quantized model variant with lower VRAM to reduce memory thrash 3) temporarily increase dedicated pool size (spin extra nodes) 4) reduce max_streaming_packet_size to limit streaming stall amplification. Which is lowest-risk to apply fast?

eng_aram: easiest/fastest: apply tenant soft-throttle + route to smaller model variant. I can push a canary route in ~3m. Spinning nodes will take 8–10m. Throttle command: `rctl tenant set-concurrency acme 200 --reason "mitigate tail latency"`

pm_claire: we should also prep customer comms. @customer_ops_acme can we notify AcmeHealth about degraded latency and that we're applying mitigation now? keep wording conservative.

customer_ops_acme: ack — i'll draft. Wait for confirmation of action before sending.

eng_aram: rolling canary now: `rctl route update acme --model redwood-llama-8q-v2 --canary 10%` -> applying. After canary success i'll flip 100% and add throttling.

sre_maya: meanwhile i've raised KV cache pinning TTL heuristics for that tenant to try and reduce cache churn: `kvcache.set_ttl(acme, 10m)` — applied. Also disabled streaming chunk coalescing for sessions from that tenant to see if stalls drop.

oncall_jordan: can someone tail the p95/p99 dashboards and streaming error rate? posting current numbers every 2m.

eng_aram: canary looks good for sample traffic (10%). Latency p95 on canary flows ~400ms, p99 ~1.1s. Flipping to 100% and setting concurrency cap now.

eng_aram: ran: `rctl tenant set-concurrency acme 200` and `rctl route update acme --model redwood-llama-8q-v2 --canary 0` (100% active). Restarted 3 pods handling the tenant to pick up route.

sre_maya: observed immediate drop in worker backlog. KV cache miss ratio down to ~28%. Streaming chunk retry rate also down ~60%.

oncall_jordan: current metrics (post-mitigation): p95 ~360ms, p99 ~980ms. Streaming stall alerts cleared. Marking incident as mitigated; keeping monitoring for 30m.

pm_claire: noted. will prepare short customer update: "We observed a transient latency spike caused by a sudden burst of very long prompts and high concurrency. We applied a temporary concurrency cap and routed you to a lower-memory quantized model to restore performance. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

customer_ops_acme: thanks — please include ask: can we get a copy of their recent prompt distribution to correlate? we'll need it.

eng_aram: filed internal follow-up ticket INF-5421 to investigate model memory behavior and allocator thrash under long-token tails. Adding traces captured during window: `https://traces.internal/trace/5421`

oncall_jordan: handing off to night oncall @sre_maya for monitoring and follow-up. If p99 climbs back above 2s reopen pager.

sre_maya: taking handoff. will keep an eye and escalate if any regression. added runbook note under the incident. :thumbsup: 

incident-bot: Incident mitigated -> status: WATCH 30m. Notify: #status-updates on resolution after watch period."
